type_constraints.description: size must be positive integer, distance in allowed values
vector dimension must match collection dimension

range_constraints.description: HNSW parameters must be within valid ranges
range_constraints.assertion: hnsw_config.m IN [2, 100] AND hnsw_config.ef_construct IN [10, 1000] AND optimizers_config.indexing_threshold >= 0

range_constraints.description: search parameters must be within valid ranges

state_constraints.description: Atomic creation; fails if collection already exists
state_constraints.assertion: collection NOT EXISTS before create AND collection EXISTS after successful create

assertions.description: Valid configuration returns 200 OK, invalid or existing returns 400
assertions.expected_behavior: returns 200 OK on success, 400 Bad Request on invalid config or if collection exists

assertions.description: Valid search returns 200 OK with scored results
assertions.expected_behavior: returns 200 OK with array of scored results sorted by similarity

behavioral_contracts.description: Created collection is immediately visible and queryable
behavioral_contracts.expected_behavior: Collection appears in list and GET returns collection details
GET returns 404, collection removed from list

state_invariants.assertion: AFTER POST /collections/{name} THEN GET /collections/{name} returns 200 AND name IN GET /collections

state_invariants.description: Deleted collection must not be visible
state_invariants.assertion: AFTER DELETE /collections/{name} THEN GET /collections/{name} returns 404 AND name NOT IN GET /collections
AFTER upsert N points THEN POST /collections/{name}/points/count returns N
